newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to pay out six pounds 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to pay out six pounds 1996 dividend.

text.p: Egyptian American Bank (EAB) will pay out a dividend of six pounds ($1.77) per share for calendar year 1996, the bank's financial year, company sources said on Tuesday.
The bank will transfer 60 million pounds from its 1996 capital increase into legal reserve to raise it to 120 million, the sources quoted management as saying at a general assembly on Monday.
In 1996, the state reduced its stake in EAB to less than 51 percent.
The share closed on the stock market on Monday at 139 pounds.
